title: been on holiday for 2 weeks so no work on game but used downtime to create some new characters on my phone, just got back and put them into a sprite sheet :)
author: stuffedcrust_studios
selftext: pretty much ChatGPT image gen for all here, occasionally used Flux Kontext to create the odd variation when ChatGPT just couldn't seem to do it.

comments.author: _stevencasteel_
comments.body: I think a few of the video models are good enough now that you can legitimately get a perfect loop image sequence for many kinds of actions. At the very least the tech is able to do Earthbound 2.0.

replies.author: stuffedcrust_studios
replies.body: The orange and red guys are inspired by TJ and Earl yeah (one of my fave games and an inspiration for the quirky tone and characters in my game). Might be a bit close to the mark with the red one haha might have to change it.

comments.author: connected_user93
comments.body: The character at the bottom with the flies does not follow the same design language as the others

replies.author: stuffedcrust_studios
replies.body: agreed, need to redo this one at some point

comments.author: odragora
comments.body:
Nice!

How is your experience with Flux Kontext? And how demanding in terms of hardware / generation speed compared to base Flux?

replies.author: stuffedcrust_studios
replies.body:
It's... ok. I find for these the results don't look as good or interesting as ChatGPT imagegen, but it can sometimes pull off some variations or prompts that ChatGPT just can't seem to get right. Sometimes it really can't as well. It's like a super backup option I've found mostly.

I been using it online at [fal.ai](http://fal.ai) so can't speak to hardware requirements.
